evidence_status: Development only. May 16-23 outcomes have already been inspected.
hypothesis: Causal sequences can learn order-flow persistence and nonlinear interactions lost by fixed temporal summaries.
loss: Cross entropy with inverse training-class-frequency weights. Convert balanced posteriors to natural posteriors by multiplying by training priors and normalizing.
features: First 26 columns of the frozen temporal_cross representation: base features, decision spread/depth/activity and contemporaneous peer features. No EWM or path-area additions.
normalization: Training-only 0.1/99.9 percentile clipping and standardization, frozen for validation and assessment.
windows: Use available causal history from 12:00 onward; score and train targets only from 12:02 to 13:59:50 UTC. Reset at each session or missing second, padding missing history with the first available observation. Windows never cross sessions.
splits: Same four training days, one validation day and one development assessment day as the frozen tabular screen; both assets, assessment May 21/22/23.
checkpoint_selection: Evaluate after every epoch; maximize validation balanced accuracy, break exact ties by natural log loss. Assessment labels are never consulted for training or checkpoint choice.
reference: Frozen validation-selected tabular reference on exactly matched assessment decision timestamps.
unseen_dates: May 24 onward remain unopened. No confirmation claim from this experiment.
